stage2.name: Wood and bamboo kiosk
stage2.desc: Thatched roof, a bigger counter, a second workbench and a little accessories display that earns money every day. Building takes one night.

stage3.name: Seafront shop
stage3.desc: Glass front, air conditioning, micro-soldering bench, stockroom and a showcase for refurbished phones. You'll be able to hire an assistant. Building takes one night.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.desc: Repairs the simple orders in the queue on their own, using parts from stock. Wants paying every evening and won't touch the soldering iron.

loan.title: Uncle Somchai lends a hand
loan.line1: Mai pen rai, kiddo. Take {amount} ฿ and start fresh tomorrow: my first year I was always in the red too.
loan.line2: Empty till, eh? Here's {amount} ฿. You can pay me back a little at a time… and meanwhile, people do talk.
loan.line3: A repairer with no money is like a long-tail boat with no engine. Take {amount} ฿ and get back to the bench.
